text: Electronic signature of forms and decisions is provided through a partner e-signature product.
Every change and action is logged with the user and time, and retention periods are set for each case type.
Historic records and documents can be migrated with trial runs, reconciliation reports and a final cut-over.
Service desk analysts answer calls from customer staff and resolve incidents against agreed targets.
A delivery lead is available to lead the implementation from contract start until three months after go-live.
